title: ADR-0019: authorize the bounded Phase 1.6 PR-0 increment
summary: Add ADR-0019, authorizing only the PR-0 increment (schemas, events, typed IDs, privacy/authority invariants) of the Phase 1.6 master spec's PR-0 through PR-8 sequence.

Per the spec's own Section 19 authority invariant, a landed planning document is not authorization; this closes that gap with a real, reviewable ADR rather than treating chat instruction as sufficient.

Deliberately does not pre-authorize PR-0.5 through PR-8: the landed spec snapshot is known-incomplete (missing a real Section 29B, Capacity Watcher polling specifics, and a Section 36 decision log) and this ADR requires revisitation before PR-0.5 begins.
risk: Low: documentation-only change; no orchestration, schema, runtime, or business-surface code is touched.
Authorizes future PR-0 implementation work but performs none itself; PR-0's own code will go through the normal PR/CI review path separately.
testEvidence: npm run docs:build passes: 117 Markdoc pages validate, including ADR-0019's required Context/Decision drivers/Options considered/Decision/Positive consequences/Negative consequences/Risks/Follow-up work/Supersedes or superseded by/Source references headings.
npm run typecheck, npm run ci:links, npm run ci:quality, and npm run ci:security all pass locally against this candidate.
documentationImpact: Adds its decision_card entry to decisions/index.mdoc and its relatedAdrs cross-reference to plans/phase-1-6-master-spec.mdoc.
rollback: Revert this bounded documentation commit through the protected pull-request workflow.
No schema, runtime, deployment, or business-data change is introduced; rollback has no production impact.
